title: Walnut Crusted Salmon with Pilaf
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring pan-seared salmon with a crunchy walnut crust, served with a light and fluffy pilaf.
instructions: Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together the chopped walnuts and a pinch of salt.
Dip each salmon fillet into the walnut mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the walnut-crusted salmon for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
While the salmon is cooking, prepare the pilaf according to package instructions.
To serve, place a salmon fillet on each plate and top with a spoonful of pilaf.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill and serve immediately.
